edit.description: widen the pair arm's identifier half; the bare-span fence stays
the pair case for an all-caps name, and the bare-span pin

summary: Widen the citation pair arm's identifier half to admit an all-caps name, per the ruled clause

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: The all-caps pair cites src/, harness/ and tests/ carry are judged by the repo citation pin, and a pair naming a declaration its file does not hold reds.
tests: a comment pairing an all-caps name with a repo-relative path reds when that file holds no such declaration
pins: a backticked word in capitals alone is judged as prose rather than as a citation subject
notes: Widen at `isIdentifierSubject` alone; `isSubject`'s bare-span fence is unchanged, which the pin holds. 13 sites gain their check today (`EX_MOUNT_DEAD`, `EX_TERMINAL_MISCONFIG`, `CORE_ENTRY_FIELDS`, `STATE_ROOT_NAMES`, `NO_COMMIT_MODES`, `DEFAULT_STATE_ROOT`, `SPAWN_OUTPUT_CAP_BYTES`, three `DEFAULT_*` in tests, `RUNTIME_IGNORES`). A site whose name does not resolve is a real find — fix it at the site, not by narrowing back.

edit.description: the `mergeFailures` field on TickResult, documented as its siblings are
fold it in beside the existing gateFailures fold

summary: Fold `mergeFailures` onto `TickResult`, off the same value the tick verdict is built from

per.section: A fact the engine holds is reported, never rediscovered

acceptance: A cherry-pick conflict names its entry, message and signature on the handoff surface rather than only on the persisted verdict.
tests: a fanout wave's TickResult reports each entry's merge failure with the signature the tick verdict recorded
notes: `TickOutcome` and `TickVerdict` carry all three stage-failure classes; `TickResult` now carries `provisionFailures` and `gateFailures` and not this one. Same fold site as the gateFailures one in `Dispatcher.tick()`, same value. Without it a conflict shows to `handoff` only as committed/not-shipped plus a `mergeOutcome`, with no signature and no quarantine key — the inference the gateFailures entry closed.
